_doc: Athena Parthenos overlay for the ruined Parthenon. Draw art/athena_parthenos/glow.png ADDITIVE (globalCompositeOperation 'lighter', alpha 0.35 + 0.1*sin(t*1.5)) centred on the statue's chest, scaled x2.2, then athena_parthenos_ghost.png (already translucent) y-sorted at base. Sizes are game px (1:1, the map is drawn at 2x). Statue = 12 m: 82 px tall equals plan scale at ws 2. Show when the player is near or the story/vision is playing.
note: world_m is metres from the Parthenon origin (generator frame): the naos, 8 m east of the temple centre along its axis (rotated -13 deg).
